agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise (0.0152) corrupts pole-angle feedback, causing the state-feedback controller to apply large erroneous forces (~39-42N at steps 40-42). This injects ~36J of work, growing oscillation from theta -0.16 at step 20 to 0.44 at step 40 to 0.71 at step 42 to 0.86 at step 43, breaching pole_upright. Removing noise alone prevents failure.
